timer-02: Stop establishes a completion barrier and cannot return until the previous callback finishes.
timer-03: Reset only changes a pending deadline; after the callback starts it cannot schedule another invocation.
timer-07: The timer contract requires the application to retry a timed-out operation exactly three times.

once-01: Copying the returned function creates separate once state, so the original callback runs once per copied value.
once-03: A panic leaves initialization incomplete, so the wrapper retries the original function on its next call.
once-07: The component requires the application to retry initialization after every panic.
